The T-shirt has a detailed graphic print on the back, depicting a stylized cat with intricate fur patterns and vibrant colors. The cat's design includes shades of blue, white, and touches of red and orange, giving it a dynamic and artistic appearance. The background of the image is plain gray, which helps to highlight the T-shirt and its design. At the bottom of the image, there is a promotional banner with the text "SHOP NOW" and "40%
